stories.title: Woman kills mother-in-law in Lucknow:Planned murder as robbery, strangled victim at home
stories.summary: Shocking details have emerged in the murder of a 69-year-old woman in Lucknow. Police revealed that the accused daughter-in-law, Ranjana Verma (36), and her 21-year-old lover Rajan Sharma had planned the killing three days in advance. During interrogation, both admitted they intended to make the crime appear like a robbery. After strangling the victim, they removed her jewellery and hid it. Police have since recovered the items based on their statements. The incident took place in Nishatganj under the Mahanagar Police Station area. Body discovered at home, last rites performed On 21 March, the body of Nirmala Devi (69) was found inside her home. Police, assisted by a sniffer dog, cracked the case within a day and arrested both accused on Sunday. Family members have since performed her last rites at Bhaisakund Cremation Ground. The accused woman’s 18-year-old son and two daughters remain at home with their father. Family background and living arrangement Nirmala Devi lived in Nishatganj, Lane No. 3, with her son Trish Verma (40), daughter-in-law Ranjana, grandson Aditya, and granddaughters Anshika (15) and Sanvi (1.5 years). Her husband, Rajaram Verma, a retired Secretariat employee, had died two years ago. Trish works on contract at Qila Power House in the electricity department, while the grandson is employed as a delivery boy. The family occupies the ground floor of a two-storey house, with eight tenants residing on the first floor. Rajan Sharma, the accused lover, was one of these tenants. Grandson discovers the body On the day of the incident, Trish was on duty, while Ranjana and her younger daughter were at home. The grandson returned around 4 pm and found his grandmother lying unconscious with her hands and feet tied. He raised an alarm, drawing neighbours to the scene. They confirmed that Nirmala Devi had died. The grandson informed his father and called his mother, who returned home shortly afterwards along with Rajan. Sniffer dog and CCTV raise suspicion During the investigation, a forensic team and dog squad were deployed. The sniffer dog stopped near Rajan, raising immediate suspicion. Further scrutiny revealed that CCTV cameras in the house had been switched off between 2 pm and 4 pm. This strengthened police suspicion of internal involvement. Footage after 4 pm showed Ranjana outside with Rajan, prompting police to detain both for questioning. Affair led to tensions within family Police investigations revealed that Rajan, originally from Gauraya Kuri Shivan in Bihar, had been living as a tenant in the house for three years. Within a few months, he developed a close relationship with Ranjana, which later turned into an affair. The family, including Nirmala Devi and her son, had become aware of the relationship. Frequent arguments followed, with Nirmala often supporting her son. She had reportedly started cooking separately just three days before the incident. Execution of the crime According to police, on the day of the murder, Ranjana called Rajan home. Together, they tied Nirmala Devi’s hands and feet and strangled her. To avoid suspicion, they switched off the CCTV cameras before committing the crime and later fled in a car. After some distance, they remotely switched the cameras back on using a mobile phone. However, when the family began calling, they panicked and returned home. Background of the accused lover Assistant Commissioner of Police stated that Rajan claimed to have been a member of an Under-16 cricket team, though he quit after not being selected further. He had been financially supported by Ranjana, who helped him purchase a car that he used as a taxi. Police are now verifying his claims regarding his cricket background as part of the ongoing investigation.

stories.title: Yogi Cabinet to meet today, 23 proposals to be discussed:Council of Ministers meeting also scheduled; poll agenda to be shared
stories.summary: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath will chair a cabinet meeting today. More than 23 proposals will be discussed in the meeting. A proposal for the formation of an OBC commission for the Panchayat elections may also be discussed. However, it has not been included in the agenda released for the cabinet. Chief Secretary SP Goyal released the agenda for the cabinet meeting to be held at 11 am in Lok Bhawan. it includes 10 proposals from the Infrastructure and Industrial Development department. It also includes a proposal for a private business park. The government has launched the 'UP Private Business Park Development Scheme-2025', which aims to assist the private sector in developing industrial parks. The government will provide loans at 1% interest and create a revolving fund of Rs 2500 crore. Such a park is being prepared for development in Bhauti, Kanpur, which will increase investment, help in easy establishment of industries and generate new employment opportunities. After the cabinet meeting, there will be a meeting of the council of ministers, which will discuss government's 9 years of achievements and coordination with workers. stories.title: Only 40% bloom on mango trees in Malihabad:Cold weather delays crop, farmers say, 'prices likely to rise this season'
stories.summary: Malihabad, widely known as the ‘mango belt’ of Uttar Pradesh, mango trees have begun to flower. However, farmers are worried as blossoms are visible on only 40–50% of the trees this season. To encourage flowering, farmers have been spraying medicines across orchards. This marks a sharp decline from last year, when nearly 80% of trees were covered with blossoms by mid-March, resulting in a strong yield. Experts say weather variability is a key factor behind the reduced flowering this year. Natural cycles and weather influence production Renowned horticulturist Haji Kaleem Ullah Khan, popularly known as the ‘Mango Man of India’ and a Padma Shri awardee, explains that flowering depends on rainfall, temperature and humidity. According to him, it is natural for mango trees to show reduced blossoming once every one to two years. His orchard, ‘Abdullah Nursery’, features over 700 varieties of mango across more than 100 orchards in the region. Despite a favourable winter, he notes that fluctuating temperatures have delayed fruit development this year. Delayed growth and smaller fruit expected Typically, by the time of Holi, mangoes begin to grow beyond the initial stage. However, this season only blossoms and tiny green grains are visible, which are yet to develop into fruitlets. Kaleem Ullah Khan indicates that while the crop will mature in due course, the fruit size is likely to be smaller than usual. Consumers may not see the large, one-kilogram Dasheri mango this year. The final yield remains uncertain, as the conversion of blossoms into fruitlets is progressing slowly. Impact of orchard conditions and airflow According to Khan, mango orchards require adequate exposure to warm air to ensure proper taste and juiciness. In densely grown orchards, trees often fail to receive natural airflow. Dew accumulates on leaves instead of reaching the ground, which can affect both flavour and texture. He suggests that orchards planted at higher levels (10–15 feet elevation) tend to perform better due to improved environmental exposure. Use of chemicals and reduced yield estimates Khan’s son, Azeem Khan, highlights the role of chemical sprays in sustaining flowering levels. He states that while last year saw 80–85% flowering, this year it is around 60%, largely due to the use of a stimulant known locally as ‘Kanta’. He notes that while such chemicals can induce flowering, they may also harm the trees in the long run. Typically, orchard owners avoid such methods, but contractors managing orchards for short periods often resort to them. Overall, he estimates that Malihabad may see only 40–50% of its usual yield this season, which could drive up prices. Weather risks: Storms and rain remain key threats Farmers are currently relieved that there has been no significant rainfall, as excessive rain can damage blossoms by turning them black and increasing humidity. However, the coming weeks remain critical. Azeem Khan warns that storms or rainfall in the next month could severely impact the crop, making protection of blossoms the primary challenge for growers. Similar trends in nearby regions The situation is not limited to Malihabad. Mango growers in nearby areas such as Kakori and Mal are also reporting reduced flowering and similar concerns about weather-related risks. Farmers from these regions supply produce to the Lucknow market, particularly Dubagga Mandi, while some export mangoes through corporate contracts. Market outlook: Likely price rise Mangoes from Malihabad are expected to arrive in markets after 20 May. Traders anticipate a price increase due to lower production. Trader Suraj Prasad Yadav explains that last year, initial wholesale prices for Dasheri mangoes were around ₹40 per kg, dropping to ₹20 within weeks. This year, prices could be at least ₹10 higher due to reduced supply. Official assessment of the situation Krishna Mohan Chaudhary, Deputy Director of the Horticulture Department in Uttar Pradesh, states that current weather conditions are still favourable. However, he cautions that rainfall could damage the crop by causing fungal issues such as ‘Dahiya disease’. He adds that fluctuations in temperature often result in varying levels of flowering each year, making such variations a recurring pattern in mango cultivation. Now know about Malihabad's mangoes

stories.title: Weather set to change across UP:Rain in 10 districts, alert for 20 more; statewide showers likely from March 26
stories.summary: It has been raining in Uttar Pradesh for the past week. Since Monday morning, 10 districts have received light rain, including Noida, Ghaziabad, Meerut and Bareilly, while Sambhal received heavy rain along with strong winds. Rain alert for 20 districts today The Meteorological Department has issued a rain alert for 20 districts today, mostly in West UP. At the same time, the weather remains clear in Purvanchal districts, with light sunshine and a cool breeze in the air. Weather to remain unstable in Western UP According to the department, Western UP will see unstable weather throughout the day, with intermittent rains. From Tuesday, a change in weather is expected and temperatures may rise by 4 to 7 degrees Celsius. Another system to bring fresh spell of rain A new Western Disturbance will become active from March 26. This may bring rain again across the entire state for 3 to 4 days. Temperature variation seen across districts In the last 24 hours, light rain was recorded in 10 districts including Barabanki and Maharajganj. Lakhimpur Kheri recorded the highest temperature at 33 degrees Celsius, while Kanpur was the coldest with a minimum temperature of 13.7 degrees Celsius. Lucknow's meteorologist Atul Singh said- Due to the effect of a very weak western disturbance, western UP is cloudy today. Intermittent rain is occurring. The weather will remain clear for the next 2-3 days. Temperatures will gradually rise. However, a new spell of rain will begin across the entire state from March 26. See pictures- How will the weather be for the next 3 days? Know the weather conditions in West UP- Damage to wheat, arhar crops due to storm, how to protect Agricultural experts say that rain and strong winds have affected Rabi, Zaid, and horticultural crops. At this time, pods are forming and grains are filling in arhar (pigeon pea), mustard, gram, peas, moong (green gram), and groundnut. Strong winds can cause pods to burst and grains to shed. The wheat crop can also fall due to strong winds, posing a risk of reduced yield. Among vegetables, the flowers and small fruits of okra, tomato, bottle gourd, cucumber, watermelon, muskmelon, eggplant, and chili can fall. Farmers have been advised to immediately harvest the ripened crop and store it in a safe place. Do not allow water to accumulate in the fields; for this, arrange for proper drainage.

stories.title: KC Tyagi joins RLD after nearly two decades:Jayant Chaudhary inducts him in party, calls return natural, aims to revive party base in western UP
stories.summary: Veteran leader KC Tyagi, who spent nearly two decades with Janata Dal (United), joined the Rashtriya Lok Dal (RLD) on Sunday. The induction took place in Delhi, where RLD National President Jayant Chaudhary formally welcomed Tyagi and his son Amrish Tyagi into the party. Tyagi remarked that his political journey had originally begun with the Lok Dal, and therefore, his return to RLD felt natural. He said there was ‘no difference’ between JDU and RLD, noting that leaders like Nitish Kumar and Chaudhary Charan Singh had once been aligned in their political vision. ‘RLD was always in my heart’ In a conversation, Tyagi said that even during his tenure outside the RLD, he continued to raise issues associated with Chaudhary Charan Singh and the party’s ideology. He emphasised that both JDU and RLD share similar manifestos and roots in the Lok Dal tradition. He recalled his long association with leaders such as George Fernandes, Sharad Yadav, and Nitish Kumar, all of whom were once part of Chaudhary Charan Singh’s Lok Dal. No ambition for posts, focus on legacy Tyagi clarified that his decision to join RLD was not driven by any desire for a position. He stated that he has already worked with several prominent leaders, including Chaudhary Charan Singh, George Fernandes, Devi Lal, V. P. Singh, Chandra Shekhar, and Karpoori Thakur. According to him, his primary aim now is to strengthen the unresolved issues linked to Chaudhary Charan Singh’s legacy and support those carrying it forward. Strategy for 2027 elections Outlining his plans, Tyagi said the goal is to make RLD strong once again, particularly in western Uttar Pradesh. He expressed his intention to empower Jayant Chaudhary and restore the party’s influence to the level it enjoyed during Chaudhary Charan Singh’s era. Having contested six elections from western UP, and winning multiple times, Tyagi said he would focus on rebuilding the party’s base in the region. ‘No one like him’ Reflecting on his long association with Nitish Kumar, Tyagi described him as a friend of 52 years and extended his best wishes to him and his family. He added, however, that “there is no one like Nitish Kumar”. Ashok Yadav also joins RLD Former Uttar Pradesh minister Ashok Yadav also joined the RLD on Sunday along with his supporters. He served as MLA from the Shikohabad constituency in Firozabad between 2007 and 2012, winning as an independent candidate. Apart from his political career, Yadav was in the news in 2019 due to serious criminal allegations, including charges of rape and extortion, which led to police action.

stories.title: Jobs of 1.86 lakh UP teachers at risk:Take UP-TET exam or complete SIR and census targets
stories.summary: In UP, 1.86 lakh teachers have not passed the Teacher Eligibility Test (TET). These teachers are from primary (Class 1 to 5) and upper primary (Class 6 to 8) schools. Among them, 50 thousand are such who cannot even appear for the exam due to not having the minimum qualification. The Supreme Court has set a deadline of September 2027 for passing TET. In such a situation, UPTET-2026, which will be held in July after four years in UP, is a big opportunity for teachers. The difficulty is that these teachers, entangled in the puzzle of SIR (Special Intensive Revision), do not understand when they will prepare for the exam amidst their duties for the national census in May? What is the exam schedule, why is it necessary for teachers to pass TET? What conditions has the Service Selection Commission added for teachers in UPTET? Why are teacher unions opposing the TET, which has been made mandatory for teachers employed before 2011? Read this report UPTET is happening after 4 years The Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission announced the schedule for the primary and upper primary level examinations on March 20. This examination is going to be held in UP after 4 years. Earlier, the application process for the examination started in 2021, but the examination could only be held in 2022. This time, 15 to 20 lakh applicants can participate in the examination. This includes 1.86 lakh teachers who are working in council schools without passing TET. One time registration mandatory The Education Service Selection Commission has made One Time Registration (OTR) mandatory for UPTET applications. All new applicants will first have to complete One Time Registration. Only after this will they be able to apply to participate in the examination. Applicants who have previously completed One Time Registration will only need to apply using their login-password. How 1.86 lakh teachers got stuck in the TET tangle Parliament passed the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act (RTE-2009) on August 4, 2009. It was implemented nationwide from April 1, 2010. Its objective is to provide free and compulsory education to every child aged 6 to 14 years, from class 1 to 8. Additionally, TET was made mandatory as a minimum qualification for teachers. By issuing an order on July 27, 2011, TET was made a mandatory service condition for recruitment at primary and secondary levels. However, on September 1, 2025, a bench of Supreme Court Justices Dipankar Datta and Manmohan ruled that all teachers with more than 5 years of service remaining would be required to pass TET within 2 years (by September 2027). Those with less service were exempted, but they too were made to pass TET for promotion. Along with this, the double bench also questioned the 2014 Karnataka Pramati Educational and Cultural Trust judgment, which granted complete exemption to minority institutions (aided or unaided) from the RTE Act. The court stated that a review of the Pramati Trust judgment is necessary. The matter was referred to a constitutional bench. Currently, the constitutional bench has not been constituted. Teacher organizations argue that the mandatory nature of TET under RTE-2009 came into effect from July 2011. In such a situation, how can it be applied to teachers appointed before this? Many teachers have been teaching for 20 to 25 years. They say that taking an exam again after so many years of service is not reasonable. Following the Supreme Court's order, 2.1 million such teachers across the country were forced to agitate. Under the pressure of the deaths of two teachers in UP and the teachers' agitation, the Uttar Pradesh government filed a review petition before the Supreme Court's double bench, comprising Justice Dipankar Datta and Justice Augustine George Masih, which is yet to be heard. New Condition Added for Teachers Applying As per the Supreme Court's directive, it is mandatory for the 1.86 lakh teachers of the state to also pass TET. If they do not pass TET before September 2027, they will have to be dismissed from service. Consequently, the Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission has added some conditions to the application for teachers as well. In the UPTET application, it will have to be stated whether you are a working government teacher. If 'Yes' is selected, you will have to fill in the type of teacher, name of the organization/school, joining date, retirement date, and Human Sampada Code. Additionally, the latest salary slip will also have to be uploaded at the time of application. 83 Marks will be the passing marks for EWS, similar to reserved categories The Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission has made a significant change in the EWS category this time. EWS has also been placed in the reserved category. This means applicants from the EWS category will need to score a minimum of 83 marks to pass UPTET. Last time, in the 2022 examination, EWS candidates were required to score 90 marks for passing. 50 thousand teachers cannot even appear for TET The mandatory educational qualification for UPTET has created a major crisis for approximately 50 thousand teachers. They do not even have the eligibility to appear for UPTET. According to Dr. Prabhakant Mishra, District President of the Junior High School Teachers' Association, Lucknow, until 1998, the minimum qualification for teacher recruitment in primary and secondary schools in the state was Intermediate and a two-year BTC. Approximately 15-20 thousand teachers are working in the state with this minimum qualification. Additionally, there are more than 15 thousand teachers who are dependents of deceased employees. After 5 years of service, they receive a trained grade as per government order. Many among them are neither graduates nor BTC pass. The third category includes people working as teachers with B.P.Ed. In the state, B.P.Ed holders were appointed as physical education teachers in primary and secondary schools in 1999 and 2004. The number of such teachers is also around 20 thousand.

stories.title: 'Consensual live-in is not a crime for married man':Allahabad HC says decisions are made by law, not morality; couple's arrest stayed
stories.summary: The Allahabad High Court said that it is not a crime for a married man to live in a consensual live-in relationship with an adult woman. The bench of Justice JJ Munir and Justice Tarun Saxena said that morality and law are different. Decisions are made based on law, not morality. The court was hearing a case from Shahjahanpur where a couple living in a live-in relationship had sought protection against threats from their family. The court, while granting interim relief, has stayed the arrest of the couple. It has also prohibited the woman's family from contacting the couple or causing them any harm. Court gives Shahjahanpur SP responsibility for couple's security In her application to the Superintendent of Police, the woman stated that she is an adult and is living with the man of her own free will. The couple also mentioned that their family is threatening to kill them, raising concerns about honor killing. Questioning the role of the police, the court said that it is their responsibility to ensure the safety of two adults. The SP of Shahjahanpur was held personally responsible for the couple's security. Girl's mother's allegation, ‘The man lured and took her daughter away’ On January 8, 2026, the girl's mother, Kanti, filed an FIR at Jaitipur police station in Shahjahanpur. In this, she alleged that on the morning of January 8, a person named Netrapal had lured her daughter and taken her away. Dharampal also helped Netrapal in this. FIR was registered against both under section 87 of BNS. This FIR was challenged in the Allahabad High Court by the petitioner girl and her partner, Netrapal. Both sought security while demanding that the FIR be quashed by the court. Court says, ‘Nothing degrading about living in a live-in relationship’ The lawyer for the girl and Netrapal told the court that the woman is an adult, as even the 'First Information Report' (FIR) filed by her mother states that the daughter's age is 18 years. Meanwhile, the girl's mother's lawyer told the court that the second petitioner is a married man, and it is a crime for him to live with another woman. On this, the court said that if a married person is living in a live-in relationship with an adult with consent, there is nothing undignified about it.

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:Surya Tilak of Ram Lalla lasts 9 minutes on Navami; govt rules out lockdown over West Asia war more
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest news updates from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top headlines: 1. Govt rules out lockdown over West Asia war Central government said that there will be no nationwide lockdown due to the crisis in West Asia. Nirmala Sitharaman has dismissed reports that suggested the government could consider a lockdown-like measure as fuel shortages loomed. 2. Surya Tilak of Ram Lalla lasts 9 minutes, 10 lakh devotees gather in Ayodhya The Ram Lalla idol's forehead was illuminated with a Surya Tilak at 12 noon on Friday on the occasion of Ram Navami in Ayodhya. This is the third Surya Tilak ceremony at Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Temple after Prana Pratishtha in the year 2024. The ceremony was held at the Abhijit Muhurat. Blue rays fell on the Lord’s forehead for nine minutes. Prime Minister Modi watched the Surya Tilak on TV. 3. Pickup crashes into trailer in Kaushambi, 8 dead 10 injured A pickup truck full of devotees collided with a trailer in Kaushambi. 8 people died in this accident. The deceased include 5 women and 3 children. More than 10 people are undergoing treatment. The accident occurred near Dorma on the National Highway in the Saini Kotwali area. Everyone was returning from Prayagraj. 4. Centre cuts excise duty on petrol, diesel by ₹10/ltr each Central Government has reduced excise duty on petrol and diesel, providing relief to oil companies and the general public. According to report, the excise duty on petrol was ₹13 per litre, which has now been reduced to ₹3 per litre. 5. Chandauli SDM’s mother alleges daughter-in-law threw acid The domestic dispute between SDM couple Anupam Mishra and Divya Ojha in Chandauli is getting complicated. Divya's father has accused Anupam of being impotent in the FIR. **Dainik Bhaskar** spoke to Shashi Mishra, mother of SDM Anupam Mishra. During this, Shashi Mishra made several shocking claims. 6. Long queues at petrol pumps, scuffles; govt warns of action against rumour spreaders In Uttar Pradesh, queues have formed at petrol pumps. On Friday, the third day of rumours about fuel running out, people continued to arrive carrying large cans and drums to fill petrol and diesel, waiting for hours due to the crowd. 7. Govt hikes commercial LPG quota for states to 70% Central Government has once again directed states to increase LPG supply amid the ongoing gas crisis in the country. Government increased the allocation or quota of commercial LPG cylinders from 50% to 70%. 8. Akhilesh takes jibe at Maurya, calls him ‘Delivery CM’ Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav took a swipe at Uttar Pradesh Deputy Chief Minister Keshav Prasad Maurya, suggesting he should become a “Delivery Chief Minister.” 9. Saudi Prince’s picture set on fire in Lucknow protest In Lucknow, Shia Muslims staged a protest against Saudi Arabia after Friday prayers, with a large crowd gathering at Asifi Mosque. Protesters burned a picture of Saudi Prince Mohammed bin Salman and raised slogans against America, Israel, and Saudi Arabia. 10. AIADMK releases 2nd list of 127 candidates for TN polls AIADMK (All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam) general secretary Edappadi K. Palaniswami on Friday released the party’s second list of candidates for the Tamil Nadu Assembly elections, naming 127 nominees.

stories.title: Pickup crashes into trailer in Kaushambi, 8 dead:Five women and three children among deceased
stories.summary: A pickup vehicle carrying devotees collided with a trailer in Kaushambi, killing 8 people, including 5 women and 3 children, while 29 others were injured. All the victims were returning to Fatehpur after attending a tonsure ceremony (mundan) in Prayagraj. The accident was so severe that several passengers were thrown out of the pickup onto the road and lay injured for a long time before help arrived. Locals informed the police and helped the injured. Police shifted the victims to hospitals by ambulance. Two people in critical condition were referred to Prayagraj, while 27 injured are undergoing treatment at the district hospital and a Community Health Centre (CHC). The accident occurred around 4 pm on Friday near Dorma on the National Highway. Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath announced ₹2 lakh compensation for the families of the deceased and ₹50,000 each for the injured. Deputy Chief Minister Keshav Prasad Maurya also expressed grief over the incident. How did the accident happen? Locals rushed to help Child whose tonsure was performed also injured The child’s mother Shimla, said they were sitting in the rear of the vehicle when the accident occurred suddenly, and everyone fell onto the road. The child also suffered injuries. A family member said around 30–35 people were travelling together for the ceremony. Inspector General Ajay Kumar Mishra said preliminary investigation suggests the trailer was parked on the highway and the pickup rammed into it from behind. CCTV footage from nearby areas is being examined, and call detail records of the truck driver and cleaner are also being analysed. Further action will be taken based on investigation findings.

stories.title: Saudi Prince’s picture set on fire in Lucknow protest:Maulana says Iran supplied oil, and India became a supporter of America
stories.summary: In Lucknow, a large crowd of Shia Muslims staged a protest against Saudi Arabia after Friday prayers at Asifi Mosque. Protesters burned a picture of Saudi Prince Mohammed bin Salman and raised slogans against America, Israel, and Saudi Arabia. They also demanded the reconstruction of the Jannatul Baqi graves. A large police presence was deployed outside Bara Imambara amid concerns about possible unrest. Protest held for construction of Jannatul Baqi Strong protest against the Saudi government Shia cleric Maulana Kalbe Jawwad told the protesting Shia Muslims, "Jannatul Baqi is the most important cemetery from the perspective of Shia belief." During this, people chanted slogans of 'Saudi government down with'. Maulana Kalbe Jawwad strongly condemned the Saudi regime. Until Saudi Arabia reconstructs the graves of the Prophet of Islam's daughter and his grandsons located in the Jannatul Baqi cemetery, we will continue to protest against the Saudi regime every year in this manner. 'Saudi Arabia has always supported countries like Israel' Maulana Kalbe Jawwad alleged that Saudi Arabia has always supported countries like America and Israel, which it calls enemies of Islam, and claimed he does not consider Saudi rulers Muslims as their mothers were from Jewish and Christian backgrounds. He further alleged that Saudi Arabia has never supported Muslims or Muslim countries. He said millions were devastated in the Gaza Strip, no buildings remained intact, and about 70,000 people died, yet Saudi Arabia stayed silent. He also alleged that some clerics and Maulanas here take money from Saudi Arabia. On Iran, he said people in India actively raised their voices against the atrocities there and extended help, adding that even Hindu brothers came forward to cooperate despite Iran not seeking assistance. 'Hindu women donated their jewellry' The oil and gas coming from Iran to India is not due to the government, but is a result of the support of the people here. The Indian government did not provide the oil; rather, it is a victory for the people. Ayatollah's grief was observed across India, and aid was sent from here, in return for which oil is being received. He also said that Hindu women even donated their earrings and jewellry, which is a significant matter. India supports America and Israel, while Iran supports India. On Pakistan's claim of mediation in this war, he said that it is wrong. Kalbe Jawwad says that a country like Pakistan, which has been accused of terrorism, cannot play the role of a mediator.

stories.title: Akhilesh takes jibe at Maurya, calls him ‘Delivery CM’:War of words over LPG shortage intensifies; Dy CM offers to send cylinders
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav took a swipe at Uttar Pradesh Deputy Chief Minister Keshav Prasad Maurya, suggesting he should become a ‘Delivery Chief Minister.’ Speaking in New Delhi on Friday, Yadav said, “Nowadays, there is a huge need for delivery boys. The Deputy CM should become a ‘Delivery CM’ and ensure essentials reach people wherever needed.” How the war of words began The exchange began after Akhilesh’s press conference in Lucknow on Thursday, where he highlighted the shortage of LPG cylinders in the state. He said that due to the scarcity, people were forced to stand in long queues and added that he had arranged for traditional cooking methods at home. “We have built earthen stoves and arranged firewood and coal. If the situation continues for a month, everyone will have to do the same,” he remarked. Deputy CM’s response Reacting to Akhilesh’s statement, Maurya said at Lucknow airport, If he does not have a gas cylinder, he should inform us. We will send one. He also dismissed claims of any shortage, accusing the opposition of spreading misinformation among the public. Akhilesh’s counterattack Responding to Maurya’s remarks, Akhilesh sharpened his attack: This is a new era where delivery boys are needed. He should become a ‘Delivery CM’ instead of Deputy CM and ensure cylinders and essential supplies reach people. Long queues for LPG and fuel Reports from across Uttar Pradesh indicate long queues outside gas agencies, with people waiting for hours to get LPG cylinders. Similarly, petrol pumps are witnessing heavy rush, with large crowds gathering to purchase fuel. While the public claims shortages, gas companies and the government have denied any supply crisis, urging people not to panic or spread rumors. CM Yogi appeals for calm Meanwhile, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath addressed the issue in Gorakhpur, linking concerns to global tensions involving the United States, Israel, and Iran. He urged citizens to remain calm and avoid panic buying. “If the conflict prolongs, it may impact everyone. There is no need to panic or pay attention to rumors,” he said. He also assured that LPG supply would continue as before and advised people not to rush for cylinders unnecessarily.

stories.title: UP IPS officers Bishnoi Anshika get romantic during engagement:Both put rings, hug and dance to 'Chal Pyaar Karegi... tune
stories.summary: UP's famous IPS KK Bishnoi and Anshika Verma got engaged. In Sambhal at 9:30 PM on Thursday, SP Bishnoi and Bareilly SP Anshika exchanged rings. Then they held each other's hands and waved them in the air expressing their joy. They also hugged each other. Both officers danced enthusiastically on stage to the song 'Chal Pyaar Karegi Haan Ji Haan Ji... Mere Saath Chalegi Na Ji Na Ji...'. During this, Bishnoi lifted Anshika in his arms. Anshika wore a golden lehenga, while Bishnoi was dressed in a black suit. The event continued until 11 PM. Several officers including Sambhal DM Dr. Rajendra Pensia were present. The remaining wedding ceremonies of both IPS officers will be held in Rajasthan. Today, March 27, the Haldi-Sangeet ceremony is in Barmer district. The wedding is on March 29 and the reception is in Jodhpur on March 30. See the engagement pictures- Met 3 years ago, then the love story began IPS Anshika Verma (30) and IPS KK Bishnoi (32) first met in 2023 during their posting in Gorakhpur. Bishnoi was SP City in Gorakhpur. Here, Anshika was an under-training IPS officer. Their love story began from here. Now both are going to get married. KK Bishnoi is a 2018 batch IPS officer of UP cadre. He is from Dhorimana village in Barmer district of Rajasthan. Currently posted as SP in Sambhal. While, Anshika Verma is a 2021 batch IPS officer. She is posted as SP in Bareilly. Anshika is from the Civil Lines area of Prayagraj. Anshika Verma is from Prayagraj. Anshika completed her early education in Noida. From 2014 to 2018, she did B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering from Galgotia College. She secured 136th rank in her second attempt at the UPSC exam. Anshika's father Anil Verma is a retired employee from UP Power Corporation Limited (UPPCL). Mother Vandana Verma is a housewife. Anshika's first posting was in 2021 at Fatehpur Sikri police station, Agra as a trainee officer. Her second posting was as ASP in Gorakhpur. IPS Anshika Verma is quite famous on Instagram. She has more than 6 lakh followers.

stories.title: Long queues at petrol pumps, scuffles in Gonda:People arrive with large containers; govt warns of action against rumour spreaders
stories.summary: In Uttar Pradesh, queues have formed at petrol pumps. On Friday, the third day of rumours about fuel running out, people continued to arrive carrying large cans and drums to fill petrol and diesel, waiting for hours due to the crowd. At Kathauta Chowk in Lucknow, the line for petrol and diesel stretches 500 metres. In Dhanepur, Gonda, a scuffle broke out at a petrol pump as people jostled to get diesel, with some pulling each other out of the queue. The Yogi government clarified on Thursday that fuel supply is completely normal and there is no need to worry about petrol or diesel. The situation is fully under control. Ranveer Prasad, Principal Secretary of Food and Logistics, said there is no crisis anywhere and fuel is being provided as per demand in all districts. Strict action will be taken against those spreading rumours. There are around 13,168 petrol pumps in the state. Pump owners said the crowd has suddenly increased three to four times. They are unsure why people are panicking despite sufficient fuel availability.

stories.title: Surya Tilak of Ram Lalla lasts 9 minutes on forehead:Idol in gold-embroidered yellow attire; 10 lakh devotees gather in Ayodhya
stories.summary: The Ram Lalla idol's forehead was illuminated with a Surya Tilak at 12 noon on Friday on the occasion of Ram Navami in Ayodhya. The Tilak ceremony lasted for the 9 minutes. This is the third Surya Tilak ceremony at Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Temple after Prana Pratishtha in the year 2024. The ceremony was held at the Abhijit Muhurat. Blue rays fell on the Lord’s forehead for nine minutes. Prime Minister Modi watched the Surya Tilak on TV. With the Surya Tilak ceremony, Ram Lalla’s divine birth was celebrated. Fourteen priests performed special rituals inside the sanctum, followed by an Aarti. After the Tilak, the curtain over Ram Lalla was closed briefly. Ram Lalla received offerings of 56 types of food. For the Surya Tilak, a 65-foot-long system of 20 pipes made of Ashtadhatu was set up. Four lenses and four mirrors directed the rays onto Ram Lalla’s forehead. Earlier, the sanctum was decorated with flowers. At 5:30 am, an Aarti was performed, and the Lord was dressed in a yellow robe. See these 3 pictures related to Surya Tilak 2024 Special food offerings for the Ram Lalla Following the symbolic birth of Lord Ram, a grand offering of 56 varieties of food was presented to the deity. This includes fruit-based fasting dishes and preparations made from buckwheat flour and water chestnut flour, along with coriander and amaranth-based sweet mixtures. The total offering weighed around 10 quintals, which was later distributed among devotees as blessed food. Technology behind the Surya Tilak This is the third time the Surya Tilak ceremony is being performed, the first being in 2024 and the second being in 2025. The system enabling this event was developed by scientists from Bengaluru. According to temple trustee Dr. Anil Mishra, specially installed equipment reflects sunlight in a way that forms a mark on the deity’s forehead, lasting for about four minutes. The nine-day festival, also known as Chaitra Navratri, concludes on Ram Navami, which marks the birthday of Lord Ram. Throughout the festival, all nine days are devoted to honouring the nine incarnations of the goddess Shakti. The festival is celebrated with great devotion across India, with rituals and prayers honouring the goddess in her various forms. Ram Navami is the day when Lord Rama appeared in his human and divine form, and is celebrated with great reverence and festivities all over India, but especially in the sacred city of Ayodhya in Uttar Pradesh. Leading up to Ram Navami, Hindus observe the 9-day fast during the Chaitra Navaratri, which consists of abstinence from alcohol, smoking, consumption of sattvic vegetarian food and immersing oneself in prayer and meditation.

stories.title: Rain in six districts, alert in 38:Clouds over 10 cities, cool winds blowing, bad weather to continue for 5 days
stories.summary: Weather conditions across Uttar Pradesh shifted on Friday morning, with rainfall reported in six districts—Lucknow, Kanpur, Ayodhya, Sitapur, Bareilly, and Sambhal. Around 10 cities, including Noida, Agra, and Meerut, experienced cloudy skies. Winds reaching speeds of up to 30 km/h have added a chill to the air, leading to a noticeable dip in temperatures. Alert issued in 38 districts; western disturbance behind shift The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a rain alert for 38 districts across the state. According to officials, the change in weather is due to the impact of a western disturbance. The department has warned that unstable weather conditions will persist for the next five days. There is also a possibility of hailstorms and strong winds in isolated areas. Temperature fluctuations recorded across the state Over the past 24 hours, the state’s average temperature has increased by up to 5°C. Banda recorded the highest maximum temperature at 40.2°C, while Muzaffarnagar registered the lowest temperature at 15.4°C. Expert insight: More rain and Strong winds ahead Lucknow-based meteorologist Atul Singh stated that winds originating from Pakistan have entered Uttar Pradesh, triggering light rainfall. He added that another western disturbance will become active on March 29, likely bringing widespread rainfall across the state. Wind speeds could increase to 40–50 km/h, and temperatures may drop by up to 3°C. See 3 weather pictures 5-day weather forecast for Uttar Pradesh

stories.title: Chandauli SDM’s mother alleges daughter-in-law threw acid:Says she took jewellery worth ₹40 lakh; wanted them sent to old-age home
stories.summary: The domestic dispute between SDM couple Anupam Mishra and Divya Ojha in Chandauli is getting complicated. Divya's father has accused Anupam of being impotent in the FIR. **Dainik Bhaskar** spoke to Shashi Mishra, mother of SDM Anupam Mishra. During this, Shashi Mishra made several shocking claims. She said - son Anupam had a love marriage. There is no question of dowry. On the contrary, we gave jewelry worth lakhs and a car to our daughter-in-law. Divya used to assault us. She had thrown acid on me. As for being impotent, after living together for 6 years, she found out that her husband is impotent? Shashi Mishra gave a point-by-point reply to the allegations of Nishikant Ojha, father of SDM Divya Allegation 1 - Demand for dowry As soon as the marriage was fixed, Anupam and his family demanded dowry. Initially, the demand was for 20 crore rupees. When refused, it gradually came down to a demand for 1 crore rupees cash, a wedding in a 5-star hotel, and a Fortuner car. We deposited 10 lakh rupees into the account before the engagement. After the wedding, we had to give 28 lakh cash, jewelry worth 40 lakh, and goods worth 7 lakh. Shashi Mishra's reply - My son had a love marriage, so there was never any talk of dowry. On the contrary, we gave jewelry to our daughter-in-law at the wedding. Today their value would be around 40 lakh. The daughter-in-law took all the jewelry with her. We also got a Creta car. My husband paid 2.56 lakh rupees, which is half the payment. There is also an entry in the passbook. She took all of that, we have nothing left now. Regarding the 28 lakh cash, how did they give it? Allegation 2 - Attempted Murder Upon not receiving the desired dowry, daughter Divya was subjected to physical and mental torture. On the night of December 7, 2025, at 2 AM, Anupam, along with his mother, launched a deadly attack on Divya. Shashi Mishra's response- Neither I nor my son ever laid a hand on my daughter-in-law. She was the one who used to hit me, Anupam, and Anupam's father. I used to serve her, massage her hands and feet. She wanted my son not to stay with me. She used to say, "Send your parents to an old age home." In winters, she would lock the house. We all used to stay outside in the cold. On the night of December 7, my daughter-in-law threw an acid bottle at me. Fortunately, the acid fell on the ground, but pieces of the bottle got embedded in my face and hand. I was treated at PHC Chandauli. I had a 2-inch wound, and I have the report too. The next day, my daughter-in-law and her father, along with 4-5 people, vandalized the house. They hit me and my son. Divya's father pushed me down and tried to strangle me. After this, they took away jewelry worth 40 lakh and my son's passport. We had complained at Alinagar police station in Chandauli, but an FIR was not registered. After this, my son filed for divorce in the Allahabad Family Court. Allegation 3- Anupam is congenitally impotent Anupam is congenitally impotent. This fact was hidden from us during the marriage. When our daughter talked about having children and treatment, she was beaten. Divya was threatened to quit her job and stay at home. Shashi Mishra's response- For 6 years of marriage, Divya didn't realize he was impotent? Both used to visit Leh-Ladakh, Nainital, Mussoorie, etc. They spent time together, both were very happy. It didn't seem at all that she was unhappy with my son. Now, after 6 years, Divya's father is making such a vile accusation against my son. Accusation 4 - Jewels, clothes seized The daughter's entire 'Stridhan' (woman's property), jewelry, clothes, and other belongings were kept by Divya's in-laws. They were not returned despite repeated requests. Shashi Mishra's response- Firstly, we didn't receive anything from their side, so what would we keep in our possession? On the contrary, she has taken away the jewelry we gave her after beating us. She has locked everything in her government house. We have nothing. The items in the house like the sofa, bed, wardrobe, all these are government property. We called SDM Divya Ojha's mobile several times to know her side of the story. However, the phone was not answered. We will update as soon as we speak to her. Now know how Anupam and Divya's love story began Anupam Mishra is from Prayagraj and Divya Ojha is from Pratapgarh. Both first met in 2020 at the PCS Training Academy (UP Academy of Administration and Management) in Lucknow. There, they fell in love and got married in December 2020. Everything was fine until 2024, then mutual disagreements began. In December 2025, troubled by quarrels, Anupam Mishra filed for divorce in the Allahabad Family Court. Proceedings on this are ongoing. On March 17, 2026, Divya's father Nishakant Ojha filed an FIR against Anupam at Alinagar police station in Pratapgarh, bringing the matter to light. Both officials have remained silent on the matter.
